desc: Ideation and structural validation: shortest paths are induced, the graph has no induced P5, so only paths of at most 3 edges need to be considered.
Implement prefix/suffix range minima and the direct/two-edge/three-edge query formula with strict inequalities.
Test samples and edge cases: touching endpoints, containment, identical intervals, empty side sets, isolated vertices, and large weights.
If tests fail, debug strict range boundaries or switch to an auxiliary segment-tree graph / per-source Dijkstra fallback.
